targeting.source: GOB 38 selector 4 and its shipped nearby-enemies text specify a caster-centred hostile area. TestFunction 2 governs the viral hit.
targeting.runtime: CasterHostileArea obtains the caster-centred area at cast completion. AbilityHostile.PlayerAreaReason checks floor, visibility, sight and hostility before the per-recipient viral contest.

PR568 repeats the sight case with a real selected obstructed target and a clear eligible hostile. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/556 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/568

targeting.source: GOB 47 stores selector 4 and a 3 m caster radius. TestFunction 2 governs the per-target deflection contest.
targeting.runtime: CasterHostileArea admits PvP-eligible players through the shared radial and sight predicate, then invokes FreeCastViralContest separately for each admitted target.
targeting.test: PR556 covers a hit and deflection inside range, with the friendly and distant targets excluded. PR568 PacketLog 5692 receives Pacify/defense debuff and immunity only on the visible hostile, while the chosen in-range hostile is blocked for mapped sight. StarterHackerAreaSightMode asserts the exclusion precedes the contest. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/556 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/568

area.source: GOB 61 reapplies 701. Child 701 is selector 4 with stored radius 6 m and no directional cone.
area.runtime: AbilityAuras.Pulse centres each 701 sample at the active caster and uses the child's radius and shared hostile recipient selectors.
area.test: PR574 puts QAOther exactly at 6 m and QAFar at 6.01 m. QAOther and the nearer QAEnemy receive the 701 pair, while QAFar and the nearby friendly receive neither record. StarterHackerAuraRadiusMode checks their personal frames. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/574

area.source: GOB 694 stores selector 4 and radius 6 m for the instant child of Static Field 89.
area.runtime: AbilityAuras.Pulse applies the caster-centred child at the GOB radius using the shared radius and hostile-player selector.
area.test: PR574 PacketLog 3052 and 3114 show the only first-pulse damage recipients at 3 and 6 m. It excludes the hostile at 6.01 m and the nearby friendly. The exact-stock bootstrap reproduces it. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/574

targeting.source: GOB 945 reapplies child 946 every four seconds. Child 946 uses selector 4, radius 3 m and TestFunction 2 before its instant Current Inner Strength -20.
targeting.runtime: AbilityAuras.Pulse filters player recipients through the hostile area checks and invokes FreeCastViralContest independently for each eligible recipient before applying the 946 debit. The paid caster upkeep is separate from the hit outcome.
targeting.test: PR574 and its replay cover the inclusive three-metre boundary and the landed hostile IS debit. In stock PR840 c9cdc0fc five pulses deflected against QAEnemy, with no victim effect, QAFar excluded for sight and QAFriend excluded as NotOpponent. The caster paid 20 IS per pulse and toggled off cleanly. FreeCastViralLandingTests.TrojanHorseDrainsOnlyNearbyHostilePlayersEveryFourthSecond covers the live predicates and the stock-frame bootstrap reproduces this deflection fixture. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/574 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/840#issuecomment-7088027020
